target: Mashup public proof showcase and local editor route

contract.purpose: Mashup turns an owned creator archive into coherent topic-specific compilations while keeping every edit inspectable.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Mashup turns an owned creator archive into coherent topic-specific compilations while keeping every edit inspectable.
contract.audience: A creator or local operator assembling comedy, motivation, podcast, or clipping compilations from approved media.
contract.job: Watch the best current result, understand how multiple episodes form one argument, inspect its sources and receipts, then decide whether to run Mashup locally.
contract.thesis: The edit, not the isolated quote, is the product; lead with the real 47-second result and make its four-part construction inspectable.
contract.system: A source-forward screening sheet using the established cool canvas, black playback wells, one blue action accent, compact rules, evidence monospace, and responsive structural stacking.
contract.signature: A four-part splice rail ties the finished video directly to its source-faithful argument map, independent score ledger, and episode provenance.
contract.risk: A public proof site could imply a hosted clipping factory, so the lifecycle boundary explicitly keeps uploads, archives, rendering, approvals, and posting local.

projectCheck.command: cd web && pnpm check && pnpm build

comprehension.reviewer: independent fresh responsive browser and source review

answers.product: Mashup turns approved long-form media into coherent, inspectable edits.
answers.audience: Creators and operators working with owned, licensed, or public-domain media.
answers.value: It builds a complete argument across episodes without losing provenance or editorial control.
answers.mechanism: The public proof exposes the authored sequence as four beats, independent score evidence, source links, captions, and validated receipts.
answers.proof: The page screens the real 47.15-second three-episode result and a 13.16-second compact cut, with recoverable source episodes and rights context.
answers.nextAction: Run Mashup locally from GitHub or inspect the release record.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner delegated portfolio landing-page rebuilding and asked that implementation depth follow canonical priority.
